calls.title: 1800Flowers Account Review
calls.summary: The team initiated an exploratory review of 1-800-Flowers' account to discover inefficiencies in their experimentation setup, aiming to provide actionable insights for customer value. Key issues included access limitations for deeper technical reviews, misconfigured tracking callbacks, and confusion surrounding holdout experiments. The discussion also highlighted the need for clearer onboarding processes and improved product features, such as better permissions and user roles. The team emphasized the importance of customer collaboration and understanding diverse workflows to refine support and enhance user experience, addressing the gaps in environment management and data practices to ultimately foster better experimentation outcomes.
calls.keywords: experimentation, environment promotion, holdouts, data tracking, experiment lifecycle, GrowthBook platform
calls.action_items:
**Chris Sanders**
Compile and share a list of key discussion points and observations from this 1-800-Flowers review meeting (57:40)
Arrange calls with customers to explore usage, challenges, and feedback on GrowthBook platform, especially related to experiments and environment promotion (57:40)
Continue evaluating broader customer patterns regarding environment promotion and multi-EAQ usage to inform potential product improvements (58:00)

**Luke Sonnet**
Investigate and clarify why 1-800-Flowers has multiple EAQs for the same user ID types and understand rationale behind their query and tracking setup (57:40)
Follow up on 1-800-Flowers' environment promotion process from UAT to Prod, and gather insights on customer experience with experiment lifecycle (58:00)

**Kari Kay**
Use insights from this session to inform UX and product design improvements focusing on onboarding, experiment setup flows, and permissions/roles usability (52:30)
Work closely with Chris Sanders to incorporate direct customer feedback into design strategy by participating in or reviewing customer conversations (57:40)
